addictionPotential: 无成瘾性且滥用潜力低。
toxicities: 相对于剂量而言毒性极低。
summary: LSD 是一种流行的迷幻剂，使用与研究历史较长，因此尽管效力极高，仍被认为相对安全。它是所有迷幻剂对比的原型，至今仍被广泛使用。
effectsSummary: Profound alterations in perception, mood, and thought. Visual hallucinations, synesthesia, ego dissolution, time distortion, spiritual experiences.
generalRisks: Psychological distress, panic attacks, paranoia, psychosis in predisposed individuals. HPPD (flashbacks). Accidents due to impaired judgment.
saferUse: Start with a low dose (under 100 µg) for your first time.
Do not drive for at least 12 hours.
